note: Pre-recorded dialogue for 'Bunty and the Lost Baby Bird'. Each line is matched to a story beat by speaker + exact text, so editing the story safely falls back to the built-in voice for changed lines.

lines.text: Bunty the boy walked happily through his sunny garden.
Chickie the tiny baby chick cried under the rose bush.
Help! Where is my mommy?
Oh! Hello, little one. Why are you crying?
I cannot find my mommy. I am lost!
Do not worry. I will help you find her.
Bunty gently looked around the garden. He checked behind the bushes and under the trees.
Do you remember where you last saw your mommy?
We were near the big tree. Then the wind blew, and I fell down.
Then let us go to the big tree together!
I am scared.
Stay close to me. Everything will be okay.
Bunty and Chickie reached the big tree. Suddenly they heard a loud chirping sound from above.
Look! My mommy! I am here!
Mimi the big blue bird flew down joyfully and landed beside her baby.
Your little one is safe with you now!
I missed you so much!
Mimi lovingly hugged her little baby with her wings.
Thank you, Bunty! You are my best friend!
You are welcome! Friends always help each other.
Mimi and her baby returned safely to their nest. Bunty walked home feeling happy.
What a wonderful day! It feels so good to help someone!
And from that day, Bunty and Chickie became special friends.
